_approach: Trap/hyperpop-style hi-hat roll build: bar 1 keeps the Jersey kick and lets the hats climb from spaced 16ths to a dense wall; bar 2 drops the kick to just the downbeat while the hat roll and a rising clap stutter carry the tension to 127, crash on the last 16th. Mirrors the hi-hat-roll build vocabulary EDMProd documents for trap/hyperpop-adjacent EDM, applied to the krushclub palette. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
